newsitem.title: USA: Allstar Inns Inc close to selling motels.
newsitem.headline: Allstar Inns Inc close to selling motels.

text.p: Allstar Inns Inc said Monday it has been notified that Motel 6 Operating L.P., Motel 6 G.P. Inc and IBL Limited Inc are finalizing financing to exercise the purchase option of 71 motels.

Under the master lease agreement, Motel 6 has the option to purchase the 71 motels from Allstar prior to the end of 1998 at a fixed price of $40 million plus the debt secured by the motels of about $206 million. Upon such purchase, Motel 6 would receive $3.0 million representing a furniture, fixture and equipment reserve.
Allstar said the closing could take place by the end of January 1997, but said it is unable to forecast whether or not Motel 6 can finalize arrangements for financing.
